text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We're catching the fever to the max today~!
Woo-hoo!
(WAAAAH!)

One day off, I arrived at "Bubbly Land,"
a pool resort that Maruzensky has frequented
since she was young.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Worked up quite a sweat.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Worked up quite a sweat.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer-chan!

From the atmosphere of the buildings to the visitors' outfits,
it feels just like slipping back in time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Caught your eye, did it?
You can rent costumes here, you know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A jacket with shoulder pads and a bodycon dress,
or maybe a soft suit!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They'll even style your hair into a perm or a sleek one-length cut. It's totally hip!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The first time I came here, I borrowed a bodycon dress and danced on the podium with my mom, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My bodycon dress was too big and I couldn't dance well... It was so frustrating...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that somehow reminds me of the old days.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...And isn't it about time for that?
(Ding-dong-dang-dong)

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"All-you-can-eat tiramisu time will now begin
at the Bubbly Café.
Please come and join in, everyone."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna chow down with everything I've got~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that was delicious! But I really can't eat
as many sweets as I used to~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Actually, when I was a kid, I won first place at an all-you-can-eat tiramisu contest.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah♪ I was feeling pretty cornered back then,
so part of it was just sheer desperation.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it was just so delicious
that I could've kept eating it forever.”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that we're fueled up,
it's finally time for what we've been waiting for: let's head to the pool♪

She must really love this place. Seeing her look
even more innocent than usual brings a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Look out, Trainer-kun!
You have to look ahead or it's dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Look out, Trainer-chan!
You have to look ahead or it's dangerous!
(Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That was fun!
I just can't get enough of that speed!
choice_data_list: Do you have memories here too?
Do you have memories here too?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, I danced on that podium,
and went down the water slide over and over
with Mom, I think.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Both of them got so absorbed in it.
Ahaha, brings back memories.
choice_data_list: You two get along well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
People often tell me we're like friends.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still... come to think of it, Mom and I
haven't come here together for a while.

Saying that, Maruzensky lowered
her voice just a little.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I haven't really been able to talk with her properly
lately. I wonder how Mom is doing?
Seeing Maruzensky look a bit downcast—a rare sight for her—I quickly made a suggestion.
choice_data_list: Let's take a great photo and send it!
Let's send them an extra-special souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice idea!
There are things around now that didn't exist back then—they're bound to love it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, let's go find
a lovely spot right away!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, isn't this just the most smashing date car ever!
What a slick photo spot~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go! Since we're here, come on,
you join in too, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go! Since we're here, come on,
you join in too, Trainer-chan!
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bubblyyy!
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fever, fever along with the setting sun♪
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that turned out to be a pretty great picture, don't you think?
Both me and Trainer-kun have wonderful smiles♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that turned out to be a pretty great picture, don't you think?
Both me and Trainer-chan have wonderful smiles♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I hope Mom gets a kick out of the nostalgia.

Looking over the photos she took,
Maruzensky smiled softly.

...That the lock screen of her smartphone
later became the photo taken that day (upside down)
is a story for another time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Isn't it wonderful! This place is filled with all of Mother's favorite things!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided,
shall we hurry over to the souvenir shop?♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A chain bag and a leather bucket bag!
Aah, but this brooch is super cute too...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
They even sell a folding fan and bodycon dress set!
Oh no, I want one too! I can't decide~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...On the other hand, how about this Bubbly Manju?
It's packed with dragées and super sparkly!"

And so, we took a look around the whole place,
but couldn't really find anything that clicked—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what should I do?
I wonder which one would make them the happiest...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I've heard this music before.
It feels somewhat nostalgicâ"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Totally rad! This is the song my mom
used to blast in the car all the time back in the day!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Except now the cassette tape is
broken, so I can't listen to it anymore...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! How about gifting this song?
I'm pretty sure there was a record shop over there!
Rushing into the record shop, I safely found the cassette tape I was looking for, and they wrapped it with care. A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Mom was thrilled.
She says she's been listening to it non-stop.

With a beaming smile on her face,
Maruzensky came to report the news.
